description.text: Decimus Junius Brutus Scaeva was a Roman politician and military man who served as a legate in 293 BC in the army of the consul Spurius Carvilius Maximus.
The following year, in 292 BC, he was elected consul, one of the highest magistracies in the Roman Republic, indicating his prominence in Roman politics.
